QUOTE: MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY off (default) ... the index doesn't know the repo's own config header, so shipped defaults are inferred and should be checked against `mbedtls_config.h`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY as a config switch and says "off (default)", but it never states that it is commented out in the shipped mbedtls_config.h. It defers that check to the reader.
